result.reason: The added operative language meets the preferred limits for CGL, E&O, cyber/privacy, and workers’ compensation and requires certificates on request. It also appropriately applies cyber coverage because IBM processes Customer data. However, requiring all coverage for one year after termination goes beyond the playbook, the existing provisions were unnecessarily reordered, and the stray “Insurance” heading appears after rather than before the provision. These issues reduce minimality and drafting quality without materially altering the unrelated commercial terms.
